full_max_score: Maximum numerator or denominator bit length among A,B,Px,Py,Rx,Ry, where integers have denominator 1 and bit_length(0)=0.
full_sum_score: Sum of numerator and denominator bit lengths among A,B,Px,Py,Rx,Ry, with sign bits excluded.
selection: For each of the 159 source events, enumerate its 27 candidates in frozen order, minimize each score with lexicographic shift tie-breaking, and compare each optimum with the centered baseline and the source point-only winner. Preserve per-event outcomes and both control classes.
measurement: exact full-witness representation accounting on the archived candidate set; no wall-time or end-to-end speed comparison
